title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.
